coverage: Local and hosted profile validation, stable ConfigRoot environment UUID and expected-hash CAS
TLS/compatibility/session probe before atomic settings publication; incompatible and actor-mismatched probes preserve prior settings
hosted selector routes allowlisted requests through HttpStore and never constructs a LocalStore fallback
local absolute checkout paths are replaced by canonical workspace IDs and are absent from the outbound request
two repository/project/branch mappings resolve independently and Host rejects a cross-scope request
native hook event IDs and session are preserved while only actor=hook record_event is rebound to the authenticated actor with original_actor provenance
CLI storage configure/status return protocol JSON and create no local database in the ConfigRoot-only setup flow

local_hook_regressions.product_calls: local fixtures only; no external model/provider calls

boundary.local_default: LocalStore behavior and existing hook CLI pending replay preserved
boundary.hosted_mode: HttpStore for Host allowlisted business operations; explicit fail-closed result for unsupported client-local operations
boundary.credentials: environment-variable reference only in storage.json; no value is stored or returned
boundary.workspace_paths: client ConfigRoot only; canonical workspace and relative graph path on Host requests
boundary.hosted_local_runtime: not connected; local Git/runner operations remain explicit unavailable until the hosted runtime adapter is connected

limitations: No hosted Git edit, document publish, CLI/native runner or model operation is claimed as complete.
Native hook events require PMT_SCOPE_ID to match one configured project mapping; scope-less events fail closed.
Device actor is the server compatibility actor. Business request actor mismatches are rejected.
